files.bt.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules targetLang="de" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../bitext.xsd" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
<category id="CAT1" name="idioms">
<rule lang="de" id="red_herring" name="Ext bitext rule">
<pattern>
	<source lang="en">
		<token>is</token>
		<token>a</token>
		<token>red</token>
		<token>herring</token>
	</source>
	<target>
		<token>ein</token>
		<token>roter</token>
		<token>Hering</token>
	</target>
</pattern>
<message>Meinten Sie <suggestion>ein Ablenkungsmanöver</suggestion>?</message>
<example type="correct"><srcExample>is a red herring</srcExample>
<trgExample>ok ok</trgExample></example>
<example type="incorrect" correction="ein Ablenkungsmanöver"><srcExample><marker>is a red herring</marker></srcExample>
<trgExample><marker>ein roter Hering</marker></trgExample></example>
</rule></category></rules>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules targetLang="de" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="../bitext.xsd" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
<category id="CAT1" name="idioms">
<rule lang="de" id="good_day" name="Ext bitext rule">
<pattern>
	<source lang="en">
		<token>good</token>
		<token>day</token>
	</source>
	<target>
		<token>Guten</token>
		<token>Tag</token>
	</target>
</pattern>
<message>Meinten Sie <suggestion>Hallo</suggestion>?</message>
<example type="correct"><srcExample>good day</srcExample>
<trgExample>ok ok</trgExample></example>
<example type="incorrect" correction="Hallo"><srcExample><marker>good day</marker></srcExample>
<trgExample><marker>Guten Tag</marker></trgExample></example>
</rule></category></rules>
